items.title: Claude Opus 4.5 Now Integrated with GitHub Copilot

items.title: Microsoft Rolls Out Baseline Security Mode for Office, SharePoint, Exchange, Teams, and Entra
items.description: Microsoft has begun deploying Baseline Security Mode across Microsoft 365 tenants, a new dashboard in the M365 Admin Center that centralizes recommended security configurations for Office, SharePoint, Exchange, Teams, and Entra. Announced at Ignite 2025, this opt-in feature helps administrators quickly assess vulnerabilities, run impact reports, and apply risk-based hardening without immediate…

items.title: U.S. DOJ Charges 54 in ATM Jackpotting Scheme Using Ploutus Malware
items.description: The U.S. Department of Justice (DoJ) this week announced the indictment of 54 individuals in connection with a multi-million dollar ATM jackpotting scheme. The large-scale conspiracy involved deploying malware named Ploutus to hack into automated teller machines (ATMs) across the U.S. and force them to dispense cash. items.title: Cybersecurity Professionals Plead Guilty to Launching Ransomware Attacks
items.description: In a shocking betrayal of industry trust, two former cybersecurity professionals have pleaded guilty to federal charges for launching ransomware attacks against U.S. businesses. The pair, whose day jobs involved helping companies respond to hacks and negotiate ransoms, admitted to moonlighting as cybercriminals in a plot to extort millions of dollars from victims.
